conventions.contract: CONTRACT_V8 §AC. Paths relative to frost-village/assets/. Fragment name: fx_city (add it to FRAGMENTS in src/core/Assets.js).
conventions.blend: Every sheet is NORMAL-blend artwork (saturated cores + darker warm / cool rims) so it reads on white snow, where ADD vanishes (handoff doc 04 §2.5). Fire / glows also look fine with ADD at night or over dark ground.
conventions.sheets: Frames left->right, wrapped into balanced rows so no sheet is wider than 2048 px (Phaser reads the grid row-major). Phaser anim key = sheet key (Assets.sheetAnims). Loops are seamless (every motion periodic over the frame count); one-shots show the effect from frame 0 and fade out on the last frames.
conventions.tone: Cute and family-friendly: comic dust-cloud scuffles (stars, no injuries), nobody is ever hurt in a fire, demolition is soft dust and planks.
conventions.icons: ui4_icons: 96x96 soft-toy icons (house style of assets/ui, ui2, ui3), anchor [0.5, 0.5], trimmed atlas with sourceSize kept; they read at 32 px on cream and dark. No text baked anywhere.
conventions.panels: Panels are plain images (not atlas frames) so Phaser NineSlice can use them; margins in nineSlice, layout boxes in sprites[key] (contentInset = [left, top, right, bottom] px from the stretched edges; *Box = [x, y, w, h] in source px).

hoseAim.arc: N = nozzle (cityfolk spray_hose nozzlePoint, or the fire truck hosePoint), T = target (fire anchor + [0, -0.3 * heightPx] or a window). Curve P(s) = N + (T - N) * s + [0, -h * 4 * s * (1 - s)] for s in 0..1 with arc height h = clamp(0.3 * |T - N|, 20, 120) px (the jet arcs up, then falls onto the target).
hoseAim.chain: Walk the curve by arc length in steps of L = stepPx: at each step place a sprite of fx_hose_stream with origin (0, 0.5) at the step start, rotation = angle of the curve tangent there, scaleX = 1.15 * L / 64 (slight overlap hides the joints), scaleY = 1.0 -> 0.7 along the arc (the jet thins). Depth: above the firefighter, below the building fire. Put fx_hose_tip at the end point with the last rotation and fx_water_mist at T. Re-aim every frame by recomputing the points (cheap: ~8 sprites).
hoseAim.rope: WebGL alternative: this.add.rope(0, 0, "fx_hose_stream", 0, points) with points sampled along P(s) every ~16 px; advance its frame with the sheet anim (one draw call, perfectly smooth bends).
hoseAim.demo: tools/test/fx_city_phaser.mjs aims streams this way; gen_fx_city_scene.hose_arc() is the Python version used by docs/previews/fxcity_scene.png and fxcity_hose_arc.gif.

fireMount.pick: Pick the fire sheet from the building footprint width fw = sprites[k].footprint[0]: fw <= 280 -> fx_fire_bld_s, fw <= 380 -> fx_fire_bld_m, else fx_fire_bld_l.
fireMount.place: Fire anchor = building anchor + [0, -0.55 * topPx] (base of the flames at about eave height so the crown engulfs the roof); scale = clamp(0.85 * fw / baseWidthPx, 0.7, 1.3); depth = building depth + 1.
fireMount.grow: Start: one fx_fire_window (alpha tween in) + fx_smoke_column at scale 0.5. Full fire: fx_fire_bld_* + 1-2 fx_fire_window + fx_smoke_column (scale 1) + fx_embers. Dying: lower the fire alpha / scale to 0.6, spawn fx_steam_puff more often, tint the smoke lighter (0xdfe4ec) -> swap the building for the civic ruin_* sprite and keep a small smoke column (scale 0.45) + fx_embers (alpha 0.5) for a while.
fireMount.alarm: fx_alarm_flash on the fire_alarm_post (or above the building, anchor + [0, -topPx - 30]) until the fire truck arrives; fx_siren_glow_red at the truck sirenPoint.

fightGuide.play: Scuffle: walk the two residents together, hide both, play fx_fight_cloud at their midpoint (ground) for 2-4 s, then fx_poof (assets/fx) and show them again apart, dizzy / sulking (emotes). A police officer arrives (police car with fx_siren_glow_red + fx_siren_glow_blue). Nobody gets hurt.
fightGuide.curious: Story network: fx_question_mark over a resident asking about something new, fx_lightbulb_idea when they learn it / get an idea, fx_memory_sparkle while recalling a memory or hearing a rumour.

spritesheets.notes: Building fire loop: a wide crown of toy flame tongues over a glowing base that melts away at the bottom (sits on the roof / wall top), warm halo, licks tearing off the top and embers. Anchor = middle of the fire base. Add fx_smoke_column above it and fx_fire_window at 1-2 windows; fx_embers for big fires. Scale = 0.85 * building footprint width / baseWidthPx (clamp 0.7-1.3). See manifest.fireMount.

Anchor = middle of the fire base. Add fx_smoke_column above it and fx_fire_window at 1-2 windows; fx_embers for big fires. Scale = 0.85 * building footprint width / baseWidthPx (clamp 0.7-1.3). See manifest.fireMount.

Anchor = middle of the fire base. Add fx_smoke_column above it and fx_fire_window at 1-2 windows; fx_embers for big fires. Scale = 0.85 * building footprint width / baseWidthPx (clamp 0.7-1.3). See manifest.fireMount.
Flames licking out of a window and up the wall, with a flickering glow of the burning room. Anchor = window centre (the bottom of the flames melts into the window). flipX freely.

Tall smoke plume loop: sooty billows from a glowing source (underside lit orange by the fire) swell, drift right with the wind and turn light grey as they rise. Anchor = base of the column: put it on top of the fire (fire anchor + [8, -0.55 * heightPx]). flipX for wind from the other side; scale 0.5 for a starting fire or a smouldering ruin.
Sparks / embers with short trails spiralling up. Anchor = bottom centre (on the fire). Use over big fires and smouldering ruins.

Fire-hose water jet SEGMENT, seamless in x, flowing toward +x by 8 px per frame. Chain copies along an arc from the nozzle to the target (see manifest.hoseAim) or map it onto a Phaser Rope. All segments play the same anim in sync.
Extra: end of the jet breaking up into a fan of droplets. Attach its anchor (left middle) to the end of the last hose segment with the same rotation.
Where the hose hits: translucent pale-blue spray cloud, splash flicks, falling droplets, glints. Anchor = impact point. Pair with fx_steam_puff while the fire is still burning.
One-shot white steam billow (water meets fire): spawn every ~0.3-0.5 s near the impact point (more often as the fire dies). Anchor = source.

Cartoon scuffle loop: tumbling dust ball with fists and boots popping out, dizzy stars, pow bursts, speed swooshes and kicked-up dust. Hide the two residents while it plays (see manifest.fightGuide). Anchor = ground under the middle.
Alarm loop: red lamp with "!" pulsing, red warning burst flashing, ringing arcs, ripple ring. Anchor = centre. Use on fire_alarm_post, above a building in trouble, police calls.

Rotating beacon (red): light fan sweeping on the ground plane, lamp flares when it faces the camera. Anchor = beacon (vehicles sirenPoint). Fire truck: red only; police car: red + blue (blue is half a turn later - start both on the same frame).
Rotating beacon (blue), half a turn after fx_siren_glow_red. Anchor = beacon.

One-shot demolition / collapse: dust ring rolls out on the ground, a cloud billows up, planks, bricks and soot bits fly. Anchor = building footprint centre; scale x1.2-1.6 for big plots; x0.6 for each excavator bucket hit.
Curious resident loop: glossy blue "?" bobbing, little "?"s popping off. Anchor = head top (character anchor + [0, -78]). Tween its scale in / out.
One-shot "aha!": bulb pops up, flickers, lights with rays + sparkles, stays lit (hold the last frame ~0.8 s, then fade). Anchor = head top.
Dreamy loop while a resident remembers: pastel twinkles and a ribbon spiral up in a soft lilac glow. Anchor = head top.

ui_icon_loan.notes: Loan: burlap money sack with a coin emblem and a blue arrow curving in (대출).

ui_icon_interest.notes: Interest: coin stack with a sprouting seedling and a green up-arrow (이자).

ui_icon_passbook.notes: Passbook: navy bank book with a gold coin emblem and a red bookmark (통장).

ui_icon_insurance.notes: Fire insurance: blue shield guarding a little house, green check (보험).

ui_icon_story.notes: Stories: open storybook with a pink heart rising out (이야기).

ui_icon_rumor.notes: Rumour: a friendly ear listening to purple whisper waves (소문).

ui_icon_question.notes: Question: speech bubble with a glossy blue "?" (질문).

ui_icon_friend_new.notes: New friend: two villager heads under a pink heart, green "+" (새 친구).

ui_icon_memory.notes: Memory: tilted instant photo of the snowy village with a heart sticker (기억).

ui_icon_move_in.notes: Moving in: house + green arrow in at the door + moving box (이사 옴).

ui_icon_move_out.notes: Moving out: house + orange arrow leaving + moving box (이사 감).

ui_icon_newspaper.notes: Town paper "솔방울 신문": folded paper with a pinecone emblem (신문).

ui_icon_badge.notes: Police: gold shield badge, blue enamel, white star (경찰).

ui_icon_wanted.notes: Wanted: pinned poster with a red band, sepia portrait and reward coin (현상수배).

ui_icon_cuffs_cute.notes: Arrest: cute toy handcuffs with a pink heart charm (체포).

ui_icon_thief.notes: Petty thief: round face, domino mask, striped beanie, cheeky grin (좀도둑).

ui_icon_fire_alert.notes: Fire alert: red warning triangle with a toy flame (화재 경보).

ui_icon_firetruck.notes: Fire engine: chubby red truck with ladder and beacon (소방차).

ui_icon_hydrant.notes: Fire hydrant: red hydrant with gold outlets and a snow cap (소화전).

ui_icon_box.notes: Parcel: kraft cardboard box with tape (택배 상자).

ui_icon_forklift.notes: Forklift: yellow forklift lifting a pallet with a box (지게차).

ui_icon_settle.notes: Settlement: receipt with a red check seal + wooden stamp (정산).

ui_icon_stock.notes: Stock: wooden rack with crates, sack, cans and logs (재고).

ui_stamp_bank.notes: Extra: red round bank seal imprint, ink only - stamp it on passbook rows / receipts.

ui_wanted_poster.notes: 현상수배 poster (fixed 224x296 image, NOT 9-slice): ribbon title band (titleBox), wooden portrait frame (portraitWindow 128x128 - draw the resident portrait there), name plate (nameBox), reward line (rewardIcon coin + rewardBox).  Also usable small (x0.3) on the civic wanted_board posterPoints.

ui_newspaper.notes: 솔방울 신문 page (9-slice newsprint): stretch to the panel size, then lay out ui_newspaper_masthead at the top and ui_newspaper_column / _photo / _divider pieces inside contentInset.

ui_newspaper_masthead.notes: Masthead strip (9-slice, stretch horizontally only, keep 96 px tall): pinecone medallions left / right, rules top and bottom.  Draw the paper title "솔방울 신문" centred in titleBox (relative to the stretched strip: x from 96 to width-96).

ui_newspaper_column.notes: Article box (9-slice): headline in the grey bar (headlineBox: x, y, width relative to the right edge, h), body text in contentInset.

ui_newspaper_photo.notes: Photo slot (9-slice): draw a snapshot / portrait clipped to the inner rect (contentInset).

ui_newspaper_divider.notes: Section rule (9-slice, stretch horizontally only, 16 px tall).

ui_passbook.notes: 통장 panel (9-slice): navy cover, cream page; bank / owner title in titleBox (above the thin rule), column titles just above the double rule at headerY, rows below - stack ui_passbook_row (32 px each) inside contentInset; stamp deposits with ui_stamp_bank (x0.3).

ui_passbook_row.notes: One passbook line (9-slice, stretch horizontally, 32 px tall).

ui_story_card.notes: Rumour / story card (9-slice): lilac band on top, speech tail bottom-left (in the margin).  Put ui_icon_rumor / ui_icon_story at iconPoint (x0.4) and the text in contentInset.

ui_story_card_news.notes: Extra: news variant (sky-blue band, blue push-pin, curled corner).  Same size / margins as ui_story_card.
